How It Works

Your Family Decides What to Do With the Money

🏠

Sized to Your Mortgage

Usually a term life policy with a benefit close to your loan balance, for about the years left on your loan.

👨‍👩‍👧

Paid to Your Family

The benefit goes to your beneficiary. They can pay off the house, keep making payments, or use it for other needs.

🩺

Optional Living Benefits

Some policies can pay part of the benefit early for a qualifying serious illness. We will show you which options include this.

Know the Difference

Mortgage Protection Is Not PMI or the Lender's Offer

🏦

PMI Protects the Lender

Private mortgage insurance covers the lender if a loan defaults. It does not pay anything to your family if you die. VA loans do not require PMI.

📉

Lender Mortgage Life

Coverage offered through a lender often pays the lender directly, and the benefit may shrink as your balance goes down.

✅

Your Own Policy

An individual policy belongs to you, names your family as beneficiary, and stays with you if you refinance or move.

Military Families

Bought With a VA Loan Near Fort Sill?

A VA loan guarantee protects the lender, not your family. It does not pay off your home if you pass away. If orders take you elsewhere, an individual policy generally stays in force as long as premiums are paid, so your coverage can move with you.

Common Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Is mortgage protection insurance worth it?

If your family would struggle to make the payments without your income, it can be. We will look at your loan balance, your existing coverage (including any coverage through work or the military) and your budget before recommending anything.

What is the difference between PMI and mortgage protection?

PMI protects the lender if the loan defaults. Mortgage protection is life insurance that pays your family if you die, so they can decide how to handle the house.

Does it pay the bank or my family?

An individual mortgage protection policy pays your named beneficiary, usually your spouse or family, not the bank.

Does the VA pay off my mortgage if I die?

Generally, no. The VA home loan guarantee protects the lender. Veterans' Mortgage Life Insurance exists only for certain veterans with severe service-connected disabilities who received a specially adapted housing grant. Check va.gov for details.

How much coverage do I need?

Many families start with the loan balance and a term that matches the years left on the mortgage, then adjust for other debts and goals. We will help you find a number that fits your budget.
